# Write It Sideways

> A comprehensive writing resource hub with 375+ articles helping aspiring and emerging writers develop their craft and overcome creative obstacles.

Write It Sideways is founded by Suzannah Windsor Freeman and serves a vibrant writer community through guides, blog articles, and curated resources. The site focuses on practical writing advice, productivity strategies, and craft techniques for novelists and creative writers.

## Key Topics

- Writing Craft
- Fiction Writing
- Productivity & Time Management
- Writing Community
- Dialogue Techniques
- Narrative Structure
- Feedback & Revision
- Overcoming Writer's Blocks
- Writing Resources
- Self-Publishing
- Editing
- Creative Partnerships
- Writing Guides
- Writer Community

## Getting Started

- [Write It Sideways Homepage](https://writeitsideways.com): Homepage with 375+ articles for aspiring and emerging writers
- [New to Write It Sideways? Start with these...](https://writeitsideways.com/start): Getting started guide for new users seeking writing advice
- [About Write It Sideways](https://writeitsideways.com/about): About page describing Write It Sideways mission and community
- [Blog for Writers](https://writeitsideways.com/blog): Main blog hub with directory of writing articles and resources

## Writing Craft & Technique

- [Why NOT Listening is Key to Writing Dialogue](https://writeitsideways.com/why-not-listening-is-key-to-writing-dialogue): Craft article on techniques for writing authentic dialogue
- [Writing "Out of Order": How to Free Yourself from Chronology](https://writeitsideways.com/writing-out-of-order-how-to-free-yourself-from-chronology): Technique guide for non-linear writing and story composition
- ["Now Where Were We?" Embracing Interruption in a Discontinuous Narrative](https://writeitsideways.com/now-where-were-we-embracing-interruption-in-a-discontinuous-narrative): Essay on narrative techniques for discontinuous storytelling

## Productivity & Mindset

- [How Self-Limiting Beliefs Are Stopping You From Writing Your Novel...and What To Do About Them](https://writeitsideways.com/how-self-limiting-beliefs-are-stopping-you-from-writing-your-novel-and-what-to-do-about-them): Guide on overcoming mindset obstacles to novel writing
- [Only Got 15 Minutes to Write? Here's How to Make the Most of Your Time](https://writeitsideways.com/only-got-15-minutes-to-write-heres-how-to-make-the-most-of-your-time): Tips for maximizing productivity in short writing sessions
- [Stop Procrastinating, and Start "Wasting Time" Instead. Here's Why.](https://writeitsideways.com/stop-procrastinating-and-start-wasting-time-instead-heres-why): Article on managing procrastination and writing productivity

## Writing Community & Feedback

- [The Pros and Cons of Joining Critique Groups for Writers](https://writeitsideways.com/the-pros-and-cons-of-joining-critique-groups-for-writers): Article exploring benefits and drawbacks of writing critique groups
- [How to Manage Feedback on Your Writing](https://writeitsideways.com/how-to-manage-feedback-on-your-writing): Guide for handling editorial feedback and revisions effectively
- [The Write Way to a Stronger Marriage: 4 Ways Co-Authoring a Book Strengthened Our Relationship](https://writeitsideways.com/the-write-way-to-a-stronger-marriage-4-ways-co-authoring-a-book-strengthened-our-relationship): Personal essay on co-authoring and creative partnerships
